history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A digital illustration with a dark blue and black color scheme, accented with glowing blue energy effects. The central focus is an anime-style character, reminiscent of Satoru Gojo from Jujutsu Kaisen, with spiky white hair, a blindfold, and piercing blue eyes. He is depicted from the chest up, with his right hand raised to his face in a gesture. Behind him, a large, glowing blue circular energy effect emanates, with a silhouette of a city skyline visible in the lower background.

Overlayed on the illustration are various text boxes and graphical elements advertising a product called "Script Waguri." The top section features the title "Script WAGURI" in large, stylized white lettering, with smaller text below reading "POWERFULL - MULTIFUNGSI - PREMIUM."

To the right of the character, there are two prominent price points:
1. A section labeled "SCRIPT WAGURI" with a price of "Rp80.000" in large, bold font, and below it "SCRIPT BOT MULTIFUNGSI FITUR LENGKAP & STABIL."
2. A section labeled "FULL BENEFIT" with a crown icon, a price of "Rp85.000" in large, bold yellow font, and below it "DAPATKAN SEMUA BENEFIT PREMIUM & EKSKLUSIF."

Below these price sections, two main columns detail the product's features:
- The left column is titled "KEUNGGULAN" (Advantages) and lists numerous benefits with bullet points, such as "2080+ fitur lengkap include premium apikey," "Menu stiker, maker, tofigure & tools lengkap," "Sewa & premium bot full otomatis," and "Online 24/7 nonstop."
- The right column is titled "FITUR" (Features) and lists more functionalities with small icons next to each item. These include "Downloader All Sosmed," "Auto Download," "Auto Sticker," "Ubah Foto Menjadi Sticker," "Menu Islami dan Pengingat Sholat," "Bisa Open Sewa Bot," "APK Premium," and "JPM Lengkap dan Ada Push Kontak." At the bottom of this column, it says "DAN MASIH BANYAK FITUR KEREN LAINNYA!" (And Many More Cool Features!).

At the bottom of the image, there are three additional boxes:
- A box with a group of people icon labeled "MASUK GRUP UPDATE" (Join Update Group) with text encouraging users to join for exclusive updates and new features.
- A box with a circular refresh icon labeled "FREE UPDATE" stating that users will receive all the latest updates for free.
- A box with a shield icon labeled "FREE PANEL 30 HARI" (Free Panel 30 Days) offering a free premium panel for 30 days with every purchase.

The very bottom of the image has a line of text: "SERVICE TERJAMIN AMAN STABIL CEPAT SUPPORT 24/7".

The overall style is a blend of anime art and digital graphic design, creating a dynamic and modern aesthetic. The lighting is dramatic, with the blue energy effects casting a glow on the character and the surrounding elements. The mood is exciting and enticing, aiming to attract potential customers to the "Script Waguri" product.
